title: Starch Concentration Protocol
author: Victor vmr Rodriguez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8gbhtsn
materials: Let stand for an hour covered.

steps.title: Prepare Plant Sample
steps.instruction: Weigh out 0.25 g of plant sample and add it to a 200 ml beaker.

steps.title: Perform First Pigment Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract pigments using acetone and heat.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 mL of Acetone (Bio Basic Inc. Catalog #AC1200.SIZE.1L) to the test tube.
Place the sample/acetone suspension in a 200 ml beaker filled with distilled water.
Heat the water until the acetone starts to boil.
Let the test tube cool for 00:30:00 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Second Pigment Extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the extraction process to ensure all pigments are removed.

substeps.instruction: Drain the Acetone (Bio Basic Inc. Catalog #AC1200.SIZE.1L).
Add 20 mL more Acetone (Bio Basic Inc. Catalog #AC1200.SIZE.1L).
Place the tube back into the beaker and heat the water until the acetone starts to boil.
Let the test tube cool for 00:30:00 minutes.

steps.title: Heat Sample in Autoclave
steps.instruction: Loosen the starch for extraction by heating the sample.

substeps.instruction: Drain the test tube.
Transfer the sample to an autoclave.
Heat for 01:00:00 hour at 135 °C.
Remove the sample from the autoclave.

steps.title: Grind and Dissolve Sample
steps.instruction: Convert the sample into a suspension using a mortar and pestle.

substeps.instruction: Grind the sample with a mortar and pestle until it becomes a paste.
Add 5 mL of distilled water to the pestle and wash to dissolve the sample into a suspension, ensuring all sample is captured.

steps.title: Transfer and Wash Suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the suspension to a test tube and rinse the equipment.

substeps.instruction: Funnel the suspension into a test tube.
Add an additional 5 mL of distilled water to the test tube using the same funnel to wash out any stuck sample particles.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Vials
steps.instruction: Divide the suspension into vials and prepare a dilution.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL of the suspension to a 3 ml vial.
Add 1 mL of the suspension to another 3 ml vial.
Mark the vials as needed.
Add 2 mL of distilled water to the vial containing 1 mL of suspension to create a 1/3 diluted sample.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Aliquot Samples
steps.instruction: Concentrate the samples and transfer the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL from each vial to two labeled PCR tubes.
Centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 1200 x g.
Transfer 100 µL from the top of each PCR tube (to avoid settled particulates) into new labeled PCR tubes.

steps.title: Calibrate and Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Use a spectrometer to measure the absorbance of the samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of distilled water to a PCR tube and use it to calibrate the spectrometer.
Insert each sample into the spectrometer.
Take absorbance readings at 610 nm wavelength.
Note the log base 10 of the absorbance percentage.

steps.title: Calculate Starch Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the starch concentration (C st) in mg/g using the following formula: C st = (A 610 * 692.7 g/mol * V ml) / (2594 * M sm).

substeps.instruction: A 610 = absorbance at 610 nm
V ml = volume in ml of water added to the sample for extraction
M sm = mass in grams of the original sample taken
